concerns.text: FR-005 and SC-001/SC-002 require a Point-Biserial correlation and paired t-test, but T026/T028 only mention generic 'statistical functions' and 'analysis pipeline'. No task explicitly implements the Point-Biserial logic or the specific paired t-test setup required by the spec.

Plan.md explicitly selects a Linear Mixed Effects (LME) model to handle nested data (responses within prompts) as a complexity tracking decision. Tasks.md Phase 5 contains no task to implement an LME model, creating a gap where the plan's required robustness analysis is missing.

FR-004 and FR-008 require the scoring model to be pre-fine-tuned on a diverse set of general scientific reasoning and validated against a gold standard. T020 only describes 'Loading and freezing' an existing model. No task exists to perform the actual fine-tuning of the proxy model on the required diverse dataset.

FR-003 requires generating up to 3 distinct candidate responses per prompt and flagging incomplete prompts. T014 ('Implement inference runner') and T017 ('Output formatting') do not explicitly include logic for looping generation to produce multiple candidates or the logic to flag prompts as 'incomplete' if <3 valid responses are generated.

FR-002 and FR-006 require CPU-only inference with specific batch_size=1 and temperature=0.7 constraints, plus a fallback mechanism for OOM. T014 and T015 do not explicitly state the enforcement of these hyperparameters or the fallback mechanism described in the spec's edge cases.

FR-007 requires recording generation failures, truncations, and scoring ambiguities in a separate audit log. T016 ('Add logging') and T032 ('Low-confidence flagging') are vague and do not explicitly mandate the creation of a structured audit log artifact or the specific logic to capture entropy/variance metrics.

SC-003 requires measuring feasibility against the 6-hour CI time limit. No task explicitly includes a 'time budgeting' or 'performance profiling' step to verify the pipeline fits within this constraint before full execution.

Stale tags: T031, T032, and T033 reference 'reviewer concern #1 (FR-006)', 'Edge Case - Ambiguous Prompts', and 'Edge Case - Inference Timeouts' respectively. While FR-006 exists, the specific 'reviewer concern' IDs and the 'Edge Case' labels do not map to existing FR/SC IDs in the current spec, suggesting these are stale artifacts from a previous iteration or an external review not reflected in the current spec.md.
